days.topic_en: Cautious Employers — Headwinds and Slower Hiring
days.topic_cn: 謹慎的雇主 — 經濟逆風與放緩的招聘

sentences.text: Is there a bigger trend that you're seeing, Alicia, from this report?

keywords.def: a larger pattern beyond individual numbers

sentences.text: Yeah, some of the other things I was worried about were the number of long-term unemployed in particular.

keywords.def: people who have been without work for an extended period

keywords.def: without a job; unemployed

keywords.def: to make up or represent a portion of something

sentences.text: So, I do worry on the demand side that firms are continuing to be more cautious in their hiring due to macroeconomic headwinds like inflation, interest rates, general uncertainty related to other disruptions to supply chains like transport routes, oil and diesel prices, tariffs.

keywords.def: the employers' side of the job market, who hire workers

days.topic_en: Raising the Bar — What the ChatGPT Era Demands of Juniors
days.topic_cn: 墊高的門檻 — ChatGPT 時代對新人的要求

sentences.text: We actually did a study, looking in particular at what's happening to the entry-level labor market for junior software engineers, cuz that's where, at least for Northeastern, we're seeing our graduates having the most difficulty in the labor market.

keywords.def: at a lower or beginning level in a profession
struggling the most

sentences.text: And when we looked at the online job postings, we found that right around the time when ChatGPT was publicly released, that a lot of firms changed their entry-level hiring standards in terms of both quantity and quality.

keywords.def: public advertisements for open positions
the criteria used to decide who to employ

sentences.text: So, we find that there's about a 15% relative decline in junior versus senior software developer vacancies.

keywords.def: a decrease compared with something else

sentences.text: So, those junior vacancies are really the ones that the college grads are going for.

keywords.def: trying to get or applying for

sentences.text: So, it's not just a STEM thing, it's really an AI thing.

keywords.def: science, technology, engineering, and mathematics

sentences.text: And we're also finding that these employers are asking for more years of experience in these junior roles, and they're asking for higher levels of skills, things like problem-solving, communication, attention to detail, lots of judgment, things that are really raising the bar for what counts as a qualified junior hire.

keywords.def: the ability to notice and handle small things carefully
setting a higher standard
